test_title: PYST 17: SSC JE CE - Reasoning (Held on: 23 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the letter - cluster that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

SGTA, UGVA, WGXA, ?, AGBA
solution:
The pattern followed here is :

The first or third letter of each word has 2 increments and the next word is received and second or fourth letter of each word is the same.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0dff8254668e3cab0ea4cc3ed90a3ac9a4b4a48d82836f026841e84fd1a027d8.png] 

Hence, **"YGZA"** is the correct answer.
